On-site production, combined heat and power, renewable supply, and energy storage should be screened against the actual load pattern. Investigate output availability, timing, efficiency, dispatch restrictions, installation conditions, and integration with existing systems. Only then apply the relevant financial assumptions. Older educational material does not establish present-day tariff rules, public incentives, or source-energy ratios.
